education_level_institution_type.label: Education level / institution type
education_level_institution_type.value: Postsecondary vocational/technical trade school provider (automotive, diesel, welding, HVACR and other trades)

program_qualification.label: Program / qualification
program_qualification.value: Hands-on technical trade programs in automotive, diesel, welding, HVACR, aviation maintenance, collision repair, electrical, robotics and more; many under a year

tuition_payment_model.label: Tuition / payment model
tuition_payment_model.value: Program tuition funded via Pell Grants, student loans, Parent PLUS, institutional/relocation/commuter grants, scholarships and some employer repayment help

completion_student_outcomes.label: Completion / student outcomes
completion_student_outcomes.value: Large cumulative graduate base across its campuses; no defined-cohort completion or employment rates given

delivery_campus_model.label: Delivery / campus model
delivery_campus_model.value: Campus-based, hands-on lab instruction at multiple U.S. campuses, with small classes; virtual tours only for prospects

notes: Accreditation, enrollment counts and outcome rates are not in the evidence.
